question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Ralph’s condition __worsened__ in the hospital.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"worsened"** means to become worse or more severe. (बिगड़ना)

 
 
• **Example: **Her condition worsened over the weekend, and she had to be hospitalized.
 
 
 
• **"Improved" **refers to becoming better or making progress. (सुधार होना)
 
 
• **Example: **After taking the medication, his health improved significantly.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'worsened' **is **'improved'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scaled **(मापा हुआ): To climb up or ascend.

 
 
• **Example:** The mountaineers scaled the peak despite the harsh weather conditions.
 
 
 
• **Traversed **(पार करना): To travel across or through.
 
 
• **Example: **He traversed the desert on foot.
 
 
 
• **Changed** (बदल गया): To make or become different.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather changed from sunny to rainy in just a few hours.
